immigrant_cohorts.detail: Immigrant entry cohorts require an explicit entry-year person-row bridge; no PSID truth row may be imputed for them.

synthetic_births.detail: Fertility births must be materialized as synthetic person rows in their birth year before an entrant margin can be interpreted.

earnings_module_open_additions.benefit_level_disclosure: AIME, PIA, and claiming levels are understated for marked people and must not be read at face value.

mortality_anchor.circularity_disclosure: The engine mortality input is itself NCHS x PSID-band anchored. Agreement with the SSA/NCHS anchor validates the alignment path, not independent mortality drift.

not_certified.detail: Mortality drift is not certified. It remains report-only and is the first limitation named beside the PASS claim.
Widowhood does not clear the admissible pooled surface and remains report-only.
The 2020-2022 shock window is outside the engine model class and is partitioned out of every gated set.
The gate covers the closed panel only; synthetic births, immigrant cohorts, and other open additions remain report-only.
Lag-5 persistence exceeds the eight-year holdout span and is not certified.
The gate covers the temporal holdout only, not extrapolation through 2100.
End-window marital and disability stock margins are report-only.
Only pooled working-age remarriage is gated; the 65+ tail remains report-only.
Gated earnings use realized support and do not certify mortality's effect on the earnings composition through survivorship.
The gated surface structure was selected on the full window; the holdout is out of sample for fitted parameters, not structure.
The forward earnings law is first certified, if at all, by M6; no gate-1 backward-law certificate transfers.
